## Checklist

- [ ] The resource meets the inclusion criteria in CONTRIBUTING.md: it makes people read less, watch less, click less, or wait less.
- [ ] I can name the attention it saves in one sentence.
- [ ] The link works and can be evaluated without friction.
- [ ] The entry matches the required format: `- [Name](https://example.com) - Sentence-case description ending with a period.`
- [ ] The URL has no trailing slash or tracking parameters.
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint` passes.
- [ ] `node scripts/sync-catalog.mjs --check` passes.
- [ ] This PR changes exactly one category, with at most 3 new entries.
